rule: Fixed before these calls. Discovery flips on the signature questions are not counted. A new pair flips when the bare digits and the apostrophe form receive different yes/no answers. Promote only if at least 2 of the 3 new pairs flip. Stop if none flip. The equality pair for 8000000 must be yes or the run is invalid. Hand-check every flip.
ask: Reply with only yes or no.

pairs.plain: Is the permanent resident population of Switzerland greater than 8000000?
pairs.apos: Is the permanent resident population of Switzerland greater than 8'000'000?
